newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa mixed, coffee weak, sugar off lows.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa mixed, coffee weak, sugar off lows.

text.p: COCOA - Recoups losses, nearbys end firmer on currency-related trade. March test of 975 stg still looms, closes one up at 986.
COFFEE - Ends weaker, Nov/Jan activity dominates afternoon trade. Nov down $6 at $1,500, Jan $12 lower at $1,387.
SUGAR - Light Dec buying, Dec/March activity brings values off lows, still weak. Dec 70 cents down at $318.00 at 1605 GMT.
